books.title: Lost in Translation
books.headline: 15 Hebrew words that change how you read
books.blurb: Each word carries far more than its usual English translation. Recover the fuller meaning, one word at a time.

books.title: The Gospel Before Christianity
books.headline: Atonement, sacrifice and redemption through Jewish eyes
books.blurb: One long argument in six parts: read the good news as Jesus' first Jewish followers would have heard it.
books.thesis: The flow runs from **context** (how first-century Jews thought), to **the meaning of blood, sacrifice and atonement**, to **why Jesus died**, to **what salvation really is**, to **what judgment and "hell" are for**, and finally to **how we should live now**.

parts.blurb: Time, truth, Eden and the earliest church
What blood, offerings and atonement meant
Salvation in the Hebrew Bible and beyond
The history and purpose of judgment
Reward, greatness and living the kingdom
